title: Arif Aiman Inspires Harimau Malaya to 3-0 Victory Over Cambodia
summary: Malaysia got their AFF Mitsubishi Electric Cup 2026 campaign off to a flying start with a dominant win.
content: Arif Aiman Hanapi scored one and assisted another as Malaysia powered past Cambodia 3-0 at the National Stadium in Bukit Jalil. Pau Martí Vicente's side looked sharp and high-pressing, restricting Cambodia to only one shot on target. Romel Morales and captain Dion Cools scored in the second half to seal the three points, putting Harimau Malaya at the top of Group A.

title: Pau Martí Vicente Prepares for Crucial Clash Against Thailand
summary: The Malaysian head coach shares insights on defensive tactics and neutralizing Thailand's Chanathip.
content: In his latest press conference, Malaysia head coach Pau Martí Vicente emphasized the need for disciplined positioning when they face Thailand at Bukit Jalil. 'Thailand is highly organized, and Chanathip can exploit any gap. We must remain compact in defense and use our pace in transitions,' Vicente stated. Harimau Malaya expects a full crowd at the stadium.

title: Injury Update: Faisal Halim Cleared for High-Intensity Match against Thailand
summary: Faisal Halim recovers from minor ankle strain and returns to starting lineup contentions.
content: Malaysian medical staff have confirmed that star winger Faisal Halim has fully recovered from an ankle knock sustained in the match against Singapore. He trained fully with the main squad today and is set to feature in the starting XI against Thailand. His presence will add crucial agility and width to Harimau Malaya's attack.

title: Shin Tae-yong Demands Focus Ahead of Vietnam Showdown
summary: Indonesia's head coach Shin Tae-yong calls for maximum concentration in the upcoming Group B finale.
content: Speaking to reporters, Shin Tae-yong expressed confidence but warned his players against complacency. 'Vietnam has an incredibly solid defense under Kim Sang-sik. They haven't conceded a single goal yet. We need to be clinical with every chance,' Shin remarked. Indonesia needs at least a draw to guarantee their semi-final spot.
